subject: Archaeology
title: Ice Core Dating: Trapped Atmospheres
description: A fast breakdown of Ice Core Dating: Trapped Atmospheres for builders.

hook.text: Air bubbles trapped in Antarctic ice are time capsules of ancient atmospheres — some are 800,000 years old.

buildup.text: Ice sheets build up one layer per year, like tree rings. Drilling down extracts a cylinder of frozen climate history.

discovery.text: Volcanic eruptions leave ash and acid layers in ice. These markers can be matched to known eruptions with exact dates.

twist.text: A mystery volcanic eruption in 536 CE caused a global winter that collapsed civilizations. Ice cores proved it was real.

climax.text: Ice cores confirmed that the Black Death coincided with climate changes — connecting archaeology to climate science.

punchline.text: Eight hundred thousand years of air, frozen in layers.

quiz.question: What did ice cores reveal about the year 536 CE?
options: A massive solar flare disrupted Earth's magnetic field
A mystery volcanic eruption caused a global winter that collapsed civilizations
A comet impact in the Pacific triggered massive tsunamis
